name: Aeternal Mentis, S.A.
summary: Aeternal Mentis, S.A. operates as a technology services firm dedicated to empowering other enterprises. The company specializes in providing the essential infrastructure and expert support required for both the development and subsequent deployment of artificial intelligence models. Their comprehensive suite of offerings includes robust computational power, AI model generation and training capabilities, dedicated development assistance, and strategic consulting services. This Spanish company was established in 2020 and maintains its headquarters in Bilbao.
